headline: Open-source tool removes Apple Intelligence from macOS 27, frees 12GB
summary: A new open-source command-line tool called RemoveMacAI quickly strips Apple Intelligence features from macOS 27, freeing up more than 12GB of storage on affected Macs.

claims.statement: A command-line, open-source tool removes Apple Intelligence from macOS 27.
